prompt:
Concept art for an HTML game called Mytharium: a fantasy terrarium where palm-sized unicorns, faeries, a mermaid and a hatchling dragon live in a large glass vivarium. Make one image per output filename, following its own description:

mytharium_scene_day.png: Wide three-quarter front view of a large 120 cm front-opening glass terrarium with a black frame, hinged glass doors and a black mesh lid carrying a long white LED grow-light bar and a domed heat lamp at the left end, standing on a walnut cabinet in a cosy dim room. Inside, a real bioactive vivarium landscape: LEFT warm dry side with pale sand, a stack of dark slate slabs under the heat lamp, echeveria and haworthia succulents, dry grass, a small pile of gold coins and gems in a stone nook, and a palm-sized red-orange hatchling dragon basking on the slate. MIDDLE a clover meadow with foxgloves, bluebells and forget-me-nots, a ring of red-and-white toadstools, a small mossy stone arch ruin and a tiny mushroom-cap cottage, with two palm-sized white unicorns grazing. RIGHT a humid side with cushion moss, ferns and fittonia around a small clear pond fed by a little waterfall that spills from the cork-bark background, and a 10 cm mermaid sitting on a mossy rock at the pond edge. A gnarled bonsai tree with cloud-pruned foliage rises left of centre with two tiny glowing faeries near it. Condensation and droplets on the lower glass; the substrate layers show through the front glass (orange clay balls, a dark mesh line, dark soil, leaf litter). Everything is to scale: the creatures are only a few centimetres tall. Photorealistic macro photography, as if shot with a real camera and macro lens. Realistic anatomy, materials and light, not cartoon, not a toy, not 3D-render plastic. Original generic fantasy designs only: no existing franchise characters or branded looks. Natural colours, soft shallow depth of field, gentle film grain.
